verify/readiness.go.patch:
diff --git a/verify/readiness.go b/verify/readiness.go
index 2b4e2d2..1dec33f 100644
--- a/verify/readiness.go
+++ b/verify/readiness.go
@@ -837,7 +837,16 @@ func RequireRunner(ctx context.Context, s *sys.Session, tools Tools, root string
 		return err
 	}
 	e := sys.Fail("environment", "acceptance_unavailable", reason+"; fix commands.acceptance.run in .kogen/project.yaml", 3)
-	e.Lines = strings.Split(Excerpt(output), "\n")
+	if excerpt := Excerpt(output); strings.TrimSpace(excerpt) != "" {
+		e.Lines = strings.Split(excerpt, "\n")
+	}
+	next := "so it exits 0 on a feature with no scenarios"
+	if !strings.HasPrefix(reason, "the runner check failed with status") {
+		next = "so it writes a Cucumber Messages report to the file named by $KOGEN_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT"
+	}
+	e.Lines = append(e.Lines,
+		"commands.acceptance.run: "+(*Redactor)(nil).Redact(command),
+		"next: fix commands.acceptance.run in .kogen/project.yaml (commit the change) "+next+", then rerun the command that was refused")
 	return e
 }
